experiences.title: Site Reliability Engineer
experiences.description: As a Site Reliability Engineer at GDP Labs, I design and implement CI/CD pipelines, troubleshoot build failures, and establish workflows to streamline deployment processes. I leverage AI-powered agents to enhance diagnostic efficiency and capture knowledge to prevent recurring issues. I also provision and test cloud infrastructure — including Kubernetes clusters — for scalability and reliability under varying workloads, and maintain comprehensive technical documentation covering system architecture and infrastructure to support the engineering team.

experiences.title: Network Administration & Technical Support Staff
experiences.description: As a Network Administrator in the Network and Systems division, I manage servers, ensure smooth service operations, and maintain the network cluster, including overseeing the Kubernetes cluster. I've documented the network topology using CDP and LLDP, migrated system applications from Docker to Kubernetes, and implemented CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and Flux CD for code integration and Kubernetes deployment. Additionally, I provide technical support and resolve issues during practicum sessions in the software laboratory.

experiences.title: PPTI Teaching Assistant - Computer Networks
experiences.company: Program Pendidikan Teknik Informatika - BCA Learning Institute
experiences.description: Delivered lectures and hands-on practicums in Computer Networks, covering subnetting, routing, ACLs, and troubleshooting, and reinforced learning through practicum-based assessments.

experiences.title: PPTI Teaching Assistant - Data Structures
experiences.company: Program Pendidikan Teknik Informatika - BCA Learning Institute
experiences.description: Taught core data structure concepts including linked lists, stacks, queues, hash tables, BSTs, AVL trees, heaps, and graphs, reinforcing understanding through reviews and practicum-based assessments.

experiences.title: Junior Laboratory Assistant
experiences.description: As a Laboratory Assistant, I guided students in technical concepts and real-world applications during practicum sessions. I completed the Tes Progresif Asisten (TPA) program, which covered various areas such as game development, business analysis, web and mobile development, and system & network administration. After my first year, I contributed to assistant training by creating a System & Network Administration case for new recruits, which included a full-stack web app, Docker orchestration, load balancing, and network configuration.
